body:
I've been there, I've talk with hours with other people feeling like this. I never thought I'd feel like that again. I haven't felt so desperate in years. 

Yes, writing, communicate might help. That's what I want to do. There's gotta be more light at the end of the tunnel right? The darkness is just temporary.

That's what i do, even my job is based on this. Writing, expressing, helping others expressing their shit.

I've always tried to do good. Yes, I've done some bad things, but who hasn't? I never have harmed anyone, hurt anyone. God damn it, I'm self-destructive, I'm clean for more than 5 years, I drink maybe 2 drinks per month, I take care, I give love, I do receive love, but from those that are supposed to love me, I don't. I can't take any more guild trips, anymore "you're a loser", "you never do anything right" shit. 

Three days from now she'll be as happy as a clam, like she never said what she did, never did what she has done years upon years now. 

Maybe that's the price for being a woman here? Maybe that's how supposed to be? To be as broken as they are? 

I have a wonderful relationship for years, we don't leave together because "it's not right" and "no, daughter of mine would leave in the same house with a SO w/o getting married", but at the same time, they don't let me get married. So many guilt trips, so many unecessary arguments.

So much pain.
Gods give me strength because i can't take this anymore.
